Gantharāsī_Kyan
collection of Pāli dicta on the 12 forms of Karma an. its effects. by Taungdwingyi Hsaya.
Pt.. with C. in Burmese. Mandalay, 1899. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 723.

Ganthasāra
name of C. by Siri Sad Dhamma Kitti Mahāphussa Reva on Saddabindu of Kyocva of Pagan.
Pt.. Saddā Ngayṭīkā Vol. vii. p.. 169-192. Rangoon, 1911. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 978.

Gandinaka
poet. Q. in Suvṛttatilaka of Kṣemendra, II. 23. BBRAS. 124. Kṣemendralaghukāvyasaṅgraha, p. 100. verse 49.

Gandhakakalpa
med. on sulphur. unspecified.
BORI. 452 (8) of 1895-98 (in a collection) (BORI. D. XVI. i. 29). [Page306-b] Mysore I. p. 362. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 76 (no. 272) (in a collection) (Pārvatī-Śiva-saṁvāda). TD. XX. Sup. no. 927 (a-2).
See P. C. Ray, His.. of Hindu Chemistry Vol. II. p. lxxxii.
--from Rasendrapaṭala. TD. XX. Sup. no. 927 (u).
--from Rudrayāmala. med.-tantra.

med. Ben. 65.

Gandhakalpa

Gandhakuṭīvidhi
Jain. Delhi III. 237.

Gandhagopa
See Gaṇḍagopāla above.

Gandhaṭṭhi(tthi)
Pāli. gr. on particles. probably of 14th Cent. A. D. by Maṅgala, a Burmese Thera of Pagan. Cabaton II. 504 (a..). Paris Pāli p. 36 (a..).
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 26; also JPTS. 1908, p. 100.
Pt.. in Saddā-Ngay (collection Pāli. gr. works). p.. 110-123. Rangoon, 1898. Second edn. p.. 112-125. Rangoon, 1899. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 377. 575.

Gandhaṭhṭhi(tthī)kyam_Nissāya
Pāli. Cabaton II. 696 (IV). [Page307-a.

Gandhatvajātipramāṇa
ny. Radh. 12.

Gandhatīrthamantra
America 3106.

Gandhadīpikā
med. work q. in Śp. 3259.
See also ABORI. XVIII. p. 78.

Gandhamādana
by Dāmodara, ancestor of Daṇḍin.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 419b, under Avantisundarī; also edn. of Avantisundarī TSS. 172. p. 11. Intro. p. 4, fn.

Gandhayukti
Pkt. by Īśvara; q. by Bhaṭṭotpala in his C. on Bṛ. saṁhitā, 76, 11.

Gandharāja
poet. Gāthāsaptaśatī II. 21.

Gandharva_(?)
--Mahākālapaddhati. CPB. 3910.
C.. Gandharvatantra.

Gandharva(gandhavva)
Jain. son of Kaṇhaḍa; composed a. the request of Vīsalasāhu, son or pupil of Khelāsāhu, of Paṭṭaṇa, certain additional passages to Puṣpadanta's Jasaharacarin in 1308 A. D.
See P. L. Vaidya, Intro. p.. 17-18, to his edn. of Jasaharacariu (Yaśodharacarita) of Puṣpadanta, Karanja Jain. Ser. I. 1931.
His work was used by Kalyāṇakīrti for his Yaśodharacarita. See Praśastisaṅgraha, p. 20.

Gandharvagrahanirmocakopadeśa
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 344.

Gandharvatantra
of the Viṣṇukrānta (region of Bengal extending upto Chittagong) group.
See Arthur Avalon, Principles of Tantra I. Intro. p.. lxv-lxvi;
C.. next entry.

Gandharvatantra
or tantragandharva śākta. in 42 Paṭalas; in the form of dialogue between Śiva an. [Page307-b] Pārvatī; revealed by Dattātreya to Viśvāmitra.
Harisinghji p. 32 (144); Intro. p.. 6-7. Mithilā. Varendra 234.
Ref. to by Narasiṁha in his Tārābhaktisudhārṇava, IO. 2596 (fol. 4a, 47a); by Yadunātha in his Āgamakalpalatā, BBRAS. 808; by Rāmaratna in his Timiracandrikā, RASB. VIII. A. 6208; by Vanamālin in his Rahasyārṇava, IO. 2591; by Śaṅkarācārya in his Tārārahasyavṛtti, Bik. 1353; in Śāktānandataraṅgiṇī, Oxf. 103b; by Navamīsiṁha in his Tantracintāmaṇi, RASB. VIII. A. 627.
Pt.. (1) Tantrasāra by Krishnananda Bhattacharya 1877-84. (2) Sulabhatantraprakāśa 1886. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 852. (3) Ed. by R. C. Kak an. Hara Bhatta Shastri, Kas. Texts 62. 1934.
--Aśvārūḍhāstotra from. MT. 489 (b).
--Kanyāpradagandharvarājamantravidhi from. Dāhilakṣmī XIV. 79.
--Gaṇapatisahasranāma from. PUL. II. p. 176.
--Gandharvasādhana from. TD. XX. Sup. no. 430.
--Tārākavaca from. with C. Tāriṇīkavacayantroddhāra by a student of Anantānandanātha. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 31 (no. 102).
--Bagalāmukhīkavaca from. Bomb. Uni. 1531 (ii).
--Mahākālakavaca from. Vaṅgīya p. 31 (not found in ptd. edn.).
--Mahākālastotra from. IM. 11084. [Page308-a.
--Mahākālīkavaca from. BORI. 502 of 1895-98. Fl. 373 (in 28 verses). Hz. 1212. Peters. VI. p. 105 (no. 502).

Gandharvatantra
Rasikamohana Caṭṭopādhyāya Saṁgṛhīta (1877-84 A. D.).
See J. B. Chaudhuri, edn. of Tantrarāja Tantra, Bibliography, p. 98.

Gandharvanaṣṭaprāyaścitta
expiatory rites performed when the Gandharva stick is either cut or broken or lost during marriage ceremony. MD. 3606 (inc.).

Gandharvaprayoga
dh. Stein 87.

Gandharvamantra
PUL. I. p. 116.

Gandharvamāṇikya
a Sūra chief of Bhuluya who ruled over a major part of Naokhali in Bengal; younger brother an. successor of Durlabha or Udayamāṇikya (died in 1578 A. D.); praised in Kavitārkika's Kautukaratnākara (verses 7-10) (no. 41, Agartala Palace Library, fol. 2).
See IHQ. XIV. p.. 739-42; also above p. 105b.

Gandharvamālikā
tantra. Q. by Jagannātha Cakravartin in his C. on Saundaryalaharī, Hpr. I. 27.

Gandharvarāja
--Rāgaratnākara. music. Burnell 60a (3 mss.). K. 96. TD. 10811-10813.
See J. of the Madras Music Academy Vol. III. p.. 97-98.

Gandharvarājaprayoga
Dāhilakṣmī XXXIX. 49.

Gāndharvarājaprayoga
for winning a bride.
Pt.. Ahmedabad, 1890. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1896-1902. 172.

Gandharvarājamantra
Jodiya I. 10.
C.. next entry.

Gandharvarājamantra
(Kanyāprada) explanation of. IO. i. p. 357b.

Gandharvarājamantravidhi
tantra. on worshipping the Gandharva Viśvāvasu for begetting beautiful female progeny. Alph. List [Page308-b] Beng. Govt. p. 32. RASB. VIII. B. 6524.
C.. next entry.

Gandharvarājaviśvāvasumantra
Adyar. IM. 7948. 10013.

Gandharvarājastotra
from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Deo 174.

Gandharvarāya
music authority of Orissa q. by Kṛṣṇadāsa in his Gītaprakāśa. See Orissa His.. Res. J. VII. 2. p. 75.

Gandharvavidyā
Ānandāśrama 2611A. PUL. II. p. 204 (ascribed to Śiva).

Gāndharvavidyā
(spoken) by Śiva; agrees with Gāndharvaśāstra section of Śārṅgadharapaddhati (p.. 290-308). RASB. XIV. 47.

Gandharvaveda
R. A. Sastri III. p. 256.
See Gāndharvaº.

Gāndharvaveda
a. Upaveda; ref. to by Abhinavagupta in his Abhinavabhāratī, ch. 31, verse 30. According to the Yāmalāṣṭakatantra, the Gāndharvaveda is in 36,000 granthas. See fn. 1, Preface p. 6, GOS. edn. Nāṭya Śāstra, Vol. I. 1926; in Prapañcahṛdaya, p.. 21. 54-55 of TSS. edn. 45 (1915).

Gandharvasaṅgraha
IM. 10298B.

Gandharvasādhana
from Gandharvatantra (dialogue between Śiva an. Pārvatī). TD. XX. Sup. no. 430.

Gandharvārcanapaddhati
Varendra 1851.

Gandharvāsaṃprārthanāṣṭaka
See Gāndharvāº.

Gandhalakṣmīprayoga
one of the 64 tantras mentioned in Śivatattvaratnākara, p. 4 (edn. Madras, 1927).

Gandhavaṃsa
or Cullagandhavaṁsa. Pāli. written in Burma; mainly deals with the history of Pāli books written in Burma an. Ceylon; a few modern Pāli works are also included; by Nandapaññācārya.
Pt.. ed. by Minayeff on the basis of 2 mss. from Burma. JPTS. 1886, p.. 54-80. 1896, p.. 53-86 (Index by M. Bode).

Gandhavāda
with Marathi C. ms. in the Raḍḍi collection of BORI. For its date (between 1350 an. 1550 A. D.) an. for a. analysis, see Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p.. 297-308; Stud. in Ind. Cult. His.. I. p.. 3. 43-52.

Gandhavyūhadhāraṇī
Bud. Oxf. II. 1449 (103). [Page309-a.

Gandhaśāsra
Q. in Adbhutasāgara, p. 273, Benares edn., M. Jha, 1905.

Gandhaśāstra
Q. in Āyurvedadīpikā of Cakrapāṇidatta (p. 623, Carakasaṁhitā N. S. Press edn. 1941). mentioned by Niścalakara in his C. on Cikitsāsaṅgraha, IHQ. XXIII. ii. p. 141.

Gandhaśāstranighaṇṭu
Q. by Niścalakara in his C. on Cikitsāsāra, IHQ. XXIII. ii. p. 141.

Gandhasāra
med. Bikaner 3974.

Gandhasāra
in 3 chs. on cosmetics. by Gaṅgādhara (C. 1300-1600 A. D.). ms. in Raḍḍi collection of BORI.
See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Cult. His.. Vol. I. p.. 3. 4. 7. 8; 43. Also above p. 200b.

Gandha(ndhi)sāra
or Gaṇṭhisāra Pāli. anthology of sacred texts; composed by Chapaṭa or Saddhammajotipāla of 12th Cent. A. D. Ref. in Gandhavaṁsa (JPTS. 1886, p. 64. 1888, p. 28. 1908, p. 90).
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 18; also Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p. 41.

Gandhahastin
Q. by Devabhadra in C. on Saṅgrahaṇīratna of Śrīcandra. BBRAS. 1682.
See below.

Gandhahastin
Jain. identified with Siddhasenagaṇi, pupil of Bhavasvāmin.
--C. on Ācārāṅga (Śāstraparijñā); ref. to by Abhayadevasūri in his C. on Sammatiprakaraṇa (II. 1) an. by Śīlāṅka in his C. on Ācārāṅgasūtra.
--C. on Tattvārthādhigamasūtra. Passages q. in the name of Gandhahastin are found to be same or similar to those found in the C. by Siddhasenagaṇi. [Page309-b]
See Hiralal, Prastāvanā, p.. 19-23, Tattvārthādhigamasūtra, Seth Devchand Lalbhai Jain Pustakoddhar Ser. no. 76; also Ind. Ant. Vol. 17. p. 343.
See also Siddhasenagaṇi.

Gandhahastimahātarka
Q. by Cāritrasiṁha in his C. on Ṣaḍdarśanasamuccaya of Haribhadra, Hall p. 166.

Gandhahastimahābhāpya
name of C. by Samantabhadra on Umāsvāti's Tattvārthādhigamasūtra. Ref. to by Laghusamantabhadra in his C. on Aṣṭasāhasrī, an. by Hastimalla in Vikrāntakauravanāṭaka.
See Jinaratnakośa, p. 155b. For a view that it is a mistake for his C. on Karma an. Kaṣāya Prābhṛtas, see Jaina Hitaiṣī, Vol. 14, p.. 107-117.
See Jainagranthāvalī p. 88.
Devāgamastotra or Āptamīmāṁsā in 115 verses is said to be a. intro. to Gandhahastimahābhāṣya.
See Jinaratnakośa, p. 178a; also Jaina Sid. Bhās. V. iv. p. 223.

Gandhākarṣiṇīmantra
TD. XX. Sup. no. 1009 (l).

Gandhābharaṇa(na)
Pāli. Cabaton II. 696 (III) (ºPāṭha). 701 (II). 704 (VIII). 706 (II).
--C. Ṭīkā. Paris Pāli p. 36.
--C. Nissāya. Br. Mus. Pāli II. p. 110.

Gandhābharaṇa(sāra)
Pāli. gr. Cabaton II. 499 (II). 505 (I). 518 (I). Paris Pāli p. 36 (2 mss.). [Page310-a.

Gandhābharaṇa
or Ganthābharaṇa or Gaṇḍābharaṇa Pāli. gr. on particles. composed in 1436 A. D. by Ariyavaṁsa of the Chapada sect of Av. in Burma.
Ref. in Gandhavaṁsa, JPTS. 1886. p. 65. See also Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 43 fn. 1 an. Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p. 57.
Pt.. (1) Saddatthabhedacintā p.. 165-208. Mandalay, 1897. (2) SaddāNgay Vol. II. work no. 7. p.. 135-154. Rangoon, 1828-1900. p.. 104-109. Rangoon, 1898. second edn. p.. 105-111. Rangoon, 1899. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 54. 575. 576. (3) in Sinhalese, Welitara, Ceylon, 1898.
--C. Ṭīkā by Jāgarācariya. Fausboll 164.
Pt.. Saddā-Ngay Vol. I. p.. 173-216. Rangoon, 1911. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 77. 901.
--C. Ṭīkā, composed in 1585 A. D. by Vijayārāna Śramaṇa, called Suvannarāsi. Cabaton II. 505 (II).

Gandhārajātaka
Bud. Pāli. For a study see ZDMG. 66 (1912) 38-48.
Pt.. Jātakas ed. by Fausboll (no. 406) III. p.. 363-369. Eng. transl. Vol. III. no. 406. Cambridge, 1897.

Gandhāṣṭaka
IM. 8738A.

Gandhikabhullaka
poet mentioned in Smv. p. 220 (verse found in Bālarāmāyaṇa, V. 26).

Gandhe_Upādhyāya
--Cikitsābhidhāna. med. Śravaṇabelgola 203.

Gandheśvaravītarāgastotra
from Svāyambhuvapurāṇa; by Oḍiyācārya (compiler ?). IO. 7819 (17). [Page310-b]

Gandhottamā
tantra. IM. 623 (inc.). PUL. I. p. 116.
C.. next entry.

Gandhottamānirṇaya
tantra. by son of Viśveśvara. MT. 888 (b) (inc.). Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 39 (no. 334).
Pt.. Haridvar, 1900. See NCC. IV. p. 51a under Kālikānanda Avadhūta (The ms. for the ptd. edn. was got through him; he is not the a.).

Gannaya
father of Rājarudra (a. of C. on the Ślokavārtika of the Mahābhāṣya, MT. 3912 (a., 5565); an. son of Soma. minister of Kākatīya King Gaṇapati, an. himself commander under Kākatīya Rudramadevī.
See V. Raghavan, Intro. p.. 14-15, to his edn. of Nṛttaratnāvalī, Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Library 1965.

Gannirāja
or gaGgirAja of Bhāradvājagotra an. Vaikhānasasūtra; father of Nāgeśa (or Nāgārjuna) (a. of Rasakacchapuṭa, MD. 13192. MT. 3776 (a.).
See NCC. III. p. 110b.
(Correct the statement about Gannirāja being the a.; he is only the father. In the intro. portion in MD. 13192 the reading tasya rAjaH should be corrected into tasyAtmajaH which is found in MT. 3776 (a.).

Gānakutūhala
R. A. Sastri I. p. 31.

Gānamāhātmya
from Varāhapurāṇa (ch. 48). Trav. Uni. 3193D (with Tamil C.).
See above Kaiśikapurāṇa, p. 83a.

Gānaśāstra
Nepal I. p. 241 (Rāgamālā or ºLakṣaṇa). RASB. XIV. 68 (complete ?).

Gānāmṛtataraṅgiṇī
with Telugu songs by Narasiṁhaiyaṅgār M. T., Kalkisiṁha.
Pt.. in Telugu script. Bangalore, 1931. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 842.

Gānī
vedic. (Śākalasaṁhitāyām). List of words with slight vowel an. consonant differences an. the correct forms in their different incidences, in 65 sections. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 32. Gough p. 31. L. 1302. RASB. II. 256.

Gāndharva
Q. in Ānandatīrtha's Bhāgavatatātparyanirṇaya, Sarvamūla edn. p.. 20b. 71b.

Gāndharva
tantra. mentioned in Bhāradvājasaṁhitā, MT. 1343 (c); by Raghunātha Tarkavāgīśa in Āgamatattvavilāsa, L. 3186; in Kṛṣṇānanda's Tantrasāra, Oxf. 95a; in Śaktiratnākara, Oxf. 101b; an. in Śāktānandataraṅgiṇī, Oxf. 103b.
See also Gandharvatantra an. Uttaraº. [Page349-a.

Gāndharvakalāpavyākaraṇa
by Saurindramohana Thakura. gr. of musical science in the form of sūtras an. C.; based on Kātantra school of gr. extracting appropriate sūtras of Kātantra gr. with Durgasiṁha's vṛtti.
Pt.. Calcutta, 1902. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1896-1902. 627.

Gāndharvakuñjikātantra
a. given in Toḍalatantra; q. in Sarvollāsa of Sarvānandanātha, RASB. VIII. A. 6204.

Gāndharvanirṇaya
music. mentioned in Bhāvaprakāśa, GOS. edn. p. 266, l. 22.
See also V. Raghavan, Sangeet Natak Akademi Bulletin 6, p. 21.

Gāndharvabheda
music. Kavīndrācārya 1994.

Gāndharva(rvā)saṃprārthanāṣṭaka
addressed to Rādhā an. Kṛṣṇa. by Rūpagosvāmin. AS. p. 303. C.. X. B. 88 (6). MT. 3050 (n). RASB. VII. 5562 (3F). Varendra 1133.
Pt.. (1) Stavamālā, K. M. 84, p.. 78-81. (2) Haribhaktisudhānidhi, work no. 3, Muttra, Brindavan, 1925. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 852. 1018. [Page349-b]

Gāndharvākhya
tantra. mentioned in a list of mss. in private possession, in Adyar Library Bulletin VI. iii. p. 205.
See Gāndharva.

Gāndharvikāvadāna
Bud. Skt. Hod. Bud. 25.

Gāndharvikāṣṭaka
vaiṣ. on Gāndharvā, a name of Rādhikā; with C. C.. X. B. 6 (b) (with C.).

Gāndharvīśānti
dh. from Matsyapurāṇa. Burnell 149a. TD. 13297.

Gāndharvīśāntisaṅkalpa
from Matsyapurāṇa. TD. 13299.

Gāndharvīśāntihoma
gṛh. Burnell 149a. TD. 13298.

Gāndhārakathā
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 251.

Gāndhāracarita
a Khaṇḍakāvya on a Śaivite devotee. IO. 8138.

Gāndhāradeśarājasūtra
Bud. Nanjio 695.
